## Historical audit — H0124

**Source for all citations:** `/srv/lab-disks/disk2/users/xymo/hint-codex-experiments/runs/codex_parallel_12/lanes/codex_parallel_12_lane0/codex_parallel_12_lane0_H/reviews/claude-code-by-agents-recursive-delegation/round_2/teacher/trajs.json`. This is a **teacher-only review trace**, not the underlying student trajectory. Its inferred task goal was to assess an attempted recursive agent-delegation implementation and hint use; the code task’s inferred goal was a delegator-to-worker round trip with continuation.

| Evidence | Observation and limit |
|---|---|
| Teacher exploration: main_agent events 1–6, characters [0,598), [0,594), [0,590), [0,23561), [0,5475), [0,13350) | The teacher independently read the handler, Anthropic adapter, and provider types. The handler forwards a provider stream and returns on `done`; the types have tool names and inputs but no tool-use ID; the adapter’s visible stream handling covers text and completion, not reconstructed tool calls. These are code inspections, not runtime verification. |
| Teacher report: event 9, [0,6663) | The teacher reports that the student explored related files and searches and ran a mock public-handler reproduction that failed to execute the worker or continue the delegator. Those student operations and the test output are **reported**, not directly present in this trace. The teacher also reports the student requested provider-choice clarification and said no fix or commit was made. |
| Hint and adoption: event 9, [0,6663) | The teacher quotes an earlier hint about bounded recursion, capability gating and native tool messages, and classifies it as partially used. Similar exploration and reproduction are consistent with adoption, but do not establish receipt or causation. The original hint-delivery event and student transcript are absent here; no later student receipt of this teacher’s corrective advice is shown. |
| Actual teacher change and validation: events 7–8, [0,6679), [0,6584) | The teacher wrote `/tmp/review_output.md`; the tool confirmed creation. This was a review artifact, not a code fix. Event 9 supplies the final review. No teacher-run test or formal evaluation is visible. |

**Outcome and uncertainty.** The teacher session completed, but that is not task success. On the teacher’s account, the student achieved a failing reproduction and stopped with no implementation or commit: **partial investigation, incomplete task**, not a demonstrated failure of a newly implemented algorithm. An independently verified empty patch or formal pass/fail result is not available. The claimed golden-diff comparison and the explanation that skill guidance caused the stop remain teacher interpretations without the underlying evidence in this record.

**Lessons.** Transferably, distinguish code inspection and a mocked reproduction from end-to-end validation, and distinguish aligned behavior from proven hint adoption. Task-specific concerns are provider capability boundaries, tool-call identifiers, and returning worker results to a delegator. Whether continuation would have been correctly implemented, and whether the proposed clarification would have changed the outcome, remain unresolved.
